Synopsis:
Astarion is enjoying himself at a party with the goblins. You've betrayed and slaughtered the tieflings and he's finally able to indulge his hedonistic side. He's drinking blood, but offers you wine. He or you can propose that you get together tonight and enjoy a little more hedonism when everyone else is asleep.

Off‑screen other party members and camp matters (Shadowheart, Wyll, Halsin, Withers/Jergal, etc.) may be present elsewhere in camp but aren't central to this exchange. Astarion is in a flirtatious, hedonistic mood: he offers you wine, mocks modest drink choices, and propositions a private, more indulgent rendezvous later when everyone else is asleep. The lines about skulls or Cazador are bitter, vengeful flourishes that reflect Astarion's past and current delight in having free rein to be cruel and pleasure‑seeking.
